remarks: City condo living at its finest!  340 Bird “Cornerstone Lofts” offers you a luxurious updated home, privacy of your own space, yet easy access to all that the West Side has to offer and a short walk to the Elmwood Village! Large front entryway with coat closet leads to thoughtful open concept layout of almost 1400 sq ft of completely remodeled space(2021)! Beautiful high ceilings, plenty of natural light, lovely vinyl plank flooring, stylish exposed brick and a living/dining area perfect for friend/family entertaining! Gorgeous kitchen features quartz countertops, island/breakfast bar, custom cabinetry, glass tile backsplash, and appliances included! Convenient 1st floor FULL bathroom and laundry (washer/dryer included)! 2nd floor “mezzanine” features primary loft style bedroom, stunning FULL bathroom, and another bedroom with 15 feet high ceiling! Walk-out balcony/terrace for more hangout space!  Lots of closet/storage space throughout the unit! State of the art high end custom window shades with remotes!  Your designated parking space is only a few steps to your front door! Come see for yourself all that 340 Bird has to offer!
